text:
Alex G.: Quick question — can we agree on the SDK header contract for tier/region hints + debug flags? Need this for the rollout next week, current ambiguity is causing console telemetry and routing mismatches.
Keiko: Do we want separate headers or a single structured header? e.g. `X-Redwood-Region` / `X-Redwood-Tier` vs `X-Redwood-Hints: region=us-west1;tier=premium`
ben-platform: Separate, tiny headers are easier for Envoy and for ACL checks. region value like `us-west1`, tier like `enterprise` or `standard`. Keep the debug flag orthogonal: `X-Redwood-Route-Debug: sample=1`.
Maya: One more: customers sometimes want to pin model family/precision (quantized vs fp32). Propose a `X-Redwood-Model-Variant` header (examples: `rw-gpt-7-q4`, `rw-gpt-7-f32`).
Alex G.: Agreed on model-variant header. Concern: header proliferation -> need whitelist + server-side validation.
ben-platform: Agreed on whitelist. Also suggest we limit accepted values and return 400 for malformed/unknown tokens. Routing layer should never trust a tier hint unless the caller's account mapping permits it.
Keiko: Telemetry implications: we should propagate these headers as tags in logs/metrics and capture the decision snapshot (input hints + effective route + fallback reason) for debugging. Retention for 30 days minimum. Also add a sparse trace sample when `X-Redwood-Route-Debug: sample=1`.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: Heads up — current canary maps `tier=v1` -> dedicated-pool-v1. If we change header names/mappings we'll need to update the canary config before rollout.
Maya: Quotas: if a request says `tier=enterprise` but the billing/account shows `tier=standard`, server must veto and route to standard. Add telemetry tag `route.vetoed=true` with `route.veto_reason=quota_mismatch` so console shows why.
Alex G.: Actionable list: 1) spec the headers and allowed values 2) implement server-side validation + veto semantics 3) expose effective route + original hints in Console trace panel 4) add reason codes for fallbacks. @Keiko can you take the console mock?
Keiko: I'll mock a trace panel: three columns — `Request Hints` | `Effective Route` | `Fallback Reason`. Each row will show region/tier/variant, and link to raw headers. Will post a pixel mock by EOD.
ben-platform: Example snippet we can put in SDK docs:
```
headers:
  X-Redwood-Region: 'europe-west1'
  X-Redwood-Tier: 'enterprise'
  X-Redwood-Model-Variant: 'rw-gpt-7-q4'
  X-Redwood-Route-Debug: 'sample=1'
```
Server should return `400` for invalid header values.
Maya: Also add metric `route.source` with values `sdk|console|policy` so we can attribute where the final decision came from. That helps with audits.
ConsoleTeamBot: reminder — add UI flag to toggle showing raw headers (security gated) and an audit link to the route decision log.
Alex G.: Thanks all. I'll draft the header contract PR and include telemetry fields + veto semantics. Meeting 10:00 tomorrow to finalize. If no objections I'll land the PR tonight. :thumbsup:
